CommunityApplications.Profile:
Official StreamPilot repository for Unraid Community Applications.
StreamPilot is a self-hosted management and analytics portal for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby - user onboarding, access expiry, Discover & Request, analytics, ColleXions, Poster Sets, Overlays, Scanner, and Native Media Automation.
Docker image: ghcr.io/jl94x4/streampilot (tags: latest, beta, nightly). Template: unraid/streampilot.xml. Support via GitHub Issues.
